SPM Panel (box-score-value redesign)

Panel-training machinery for the windowed, role-pooled SPM redesign (Wave 2)

assert_asof_panel_window()
Assert that an as-of training panel for eval vintage Y contains no rows from a LATER vintage
assert_grouped_player_folds()
Assert that no player straddles more than one CV fold
build_spm_panel()
Build the SPM training panel: one row per (player, vintage year)
classify_role_group()
Map a 16-role code (classify_role() output) to the plan's 6-group role taxonomy
fit_spm_panel()
Fit a role-pooled elastic-net SPM model on the panel, predicting the windowed prior-free RAPM target
fit_spm_panel_xgb()
Fit the XGBoost half of the S6 panel SPM (player-grouped CV)
make_grouped_player_foldid()
Assign player-grouped CV fold ids: every row for a given player_id lands in the same fold
predict_spm_panel()
Score panel rows against a fit_spm_panel() model
predict_spm_panel_net()
Score panel rows against a fitted offense/defense pair, combining to a net prediction
predict_spm_panel_xgb()
Score panel-shaped rows with a fit_spm_panel_xgb() model

Constants

Package-wide constants and thresholds

BETA_PRIOR_ALPHA
Beta prior alpha for finishing modifier (shrinkage toward 1.0)
CHAIN_TIME_GAP_SECONDS
Time gap threshold for chain breaks (seconds)
CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
Default confidence level for statistical intervals
HALFTIME_MINUTE
Minute marking halftime (end of first half)
MINUTES_PER_MATCH
Minutes per regulation match
MIN_GAMES_FOR_PADDING
Default minimum games for Bayesian padding full weight
MIN_MINUTES_FEATURES
Default minimum minutes for player feature matrix
MIN_MINUTES_RAPM
Default minimum minutes for RAPM matrix inclusion
MIN_MINUTES_SPM
Default minimum minutes for SPM/player stats functions
MIN_SEQUENCES_PER_MATCH
Minimum estimated sequences per team per match
MIN_SHOTS_FOR_FINISHING
Default minimum shots for finishing modifier calculation
MIN_WEIGHT_DURATION
Minimum weight threshold for duration-based weighting
PENALTY_SHOOTOUT_CONVERSION
Empirical penalty-shootout conversion rate
PENALTY_XG
Default penalty kick xG value
PLAYERS_PER_TEAM
Players per team in standard lineup
SIX_YARD_X_MIN
Six-yard box x threshold (attacking end)
SIX_YARD_Y_MAX
Six-yard box y upper bound
SIX_YARD_Y_MIN
Six-yard box y lower bound
TOUCHES_PER_SEQUENCE
Average touches per possession sequence (approximation)
XG_MAX
Maximum xG value (caps extreme predictions)
XG_MIN
Minimum xG value (prevents 0 in log calculations)
